summary: Invisible rate-limit persists after dedicated pool lease transfer causing intermittent 429s
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports persistent 429 throttling immediately after an operator-initiated lease transfer of their Dedicated GPU pool. Throttles appear sporadically for some API keys served from the same pool despite console showing full capacity.

Impact: Several ingestion pipelines and low-latency chat endpoints received intermittent 429s for ~12 hours, causing degraded throughput for the customer's real-time features. Error rate peaked at 18% for short windows. Customer reports increased latency and partial data loss from backfilled batches.

Environment: Dedicated pool (dp-vec-01) in prod-us-east; tenant VectorSight; operator performed lease transfer (handoff to new host group) at 2026-03-09T23:40:00Z. Canary route and background embed pipelines were active.

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1. Operator initiated lease transfer for dp-vec-01 (scheduled maintenance).
2. Routing moved sessions to new host group; warmup happened.
3. After transfer, certain API keys intermittently received 429s while others on same tenant remained OK.
4. 429s persisted across small restarts of edge proxies but resolved temporarily after forcing per-tenant quota refresh.

Logs / snippets: 
- Gateway logs: "quota_check: tenant_quota_exhausted=true tenant=vecsight key=k-user-*** route=/v1/chat -> 429"
- Quota service: "refill_latency: 14s (expected < 200ms) for tenant vecsight after lease transfer)"
- Autoscaler: "pool dp-vec-01 host_swap completed; KV cache reset"

Investigation notes: 
- Hypothesis 1: Token-bucket state was partially lost/duplicated during lease transfer leading to silent per-key accounting mismatch between edge and origin.
- Hypothesis 2: Signed-url / ephemeral-key fanout from background workers caused hidden rapid token consumption, but only after the lease transfer because refill windows were misaligned.
- We observed a ~10-15s refill processing lag in quota reconciler immediately following the lease handoff which coincides with customer 429 spikes.
- Per-tenant quota counters on console showed available credits, but edge-level token caches still reported zero for a subset of connections. This indicates stale in-memory windows in edge proxies.

Temporary mitigation applied: 
- Triggered manual quota refresh for the tenant which cleared edge caches and removed immediate 429s (done 2026-03-10T03:12:00Z).
- Recommended customer to stagger background bulk-ingest jobs during ongoing operator ops.

Reproducibility: Intermittent; reliably appears when: lease transfer + concurrent bursty ephemeral-key issuance + active canary route. No repro on isolated lease transfer in QA.

Next steps (investigation / permanent fix): 
- Engineering to add a lease-transfer hook that triggers an edge-level quota cache invalidation for impacted tenants during host swap. (ENG-INV-790321)
- Add telemetry to detect refill latency > 1s post-host-swap and auto-trigger cache sync.
- Review quota reconciler backpressure that caused 10-15s refill lag; optimize refill pipeline or run reconciliation with higher priority for dedicated pools.
- Create a postmortem runbook entry and update Dedicated Lease Transfer runbook to include quota invalidation step.

Customer communication plan: 
- Sent initial acknowledgement and workaround (manual refresh) 2026-03-10 04:30 UTC.
- Committed to ETA for permanent fix: 2 weeks. Scheduled follow-up with customer engineering on 2026-03-15.
comments: Support (Aisha Kapur) 2026-03-10: Initial triage completed. Confirmed 429s correlate with operator maintenance window. Asked engineering to prioritize quota-refresh workaround.
SRE (Olga Petrov) 2026-03-10: Collected quota_service and gateway traces. Observed refill latency spike and partial in-memory window mismatch on edges used by dp-vec-01.
Eng (Miguel Santos) 2026-03-11: Added temporary handler to force edge cache invalidation post-lease; deployed canary to us-east. Early results show reduced 429s but need further hardening.
Customer (VectorSight, Evan Liu) 2026-03-12: Confirmed manual refresh restored throughput; requested timeline for permanent fix and whether similar maintenance will require customer action in future.
resolution: Workaround: edge-level quota cache invalidation (manual) and recommendation to avoid bulk warmups during host swap. Permanent fix in progress (quota reconciler optimization + automated cache invalidation hook).
workaround: Manual quota refresh via support command 'tenant-quota-refresh vecsight' cleared in-memory windows and resolved 429s temporarily. Recommend scheduling background ingest off maintenance windows.
follow_up_actions: ENG: implement automatic edge quota invalidation on lease transfer
SRE: add refill-latency alerting for dedicated pools
DX: update runbook and customer-facing guidance for dedicated maintenance
customer_impact_summary: Intermittent 429s for real-time chat and batch embed pipelines during and for a short window after an operator-initiated dedicated pool lease transfer. Partial data loss from backfill retries; customer experienced reduced throughput and increased error rates.
notes_for_billing: No charge adjustments requested. Customer asks to log incident for SLA review if recurring.
